text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moslem Croat federation's new president and prime minister are due to be appointed at today's session of the House of Representatives of the federation parliament.

- Bosnian Croat news agency Habena quotes Biljana Plavsic, president of the Bosnian Serb republic as saying "if they attack the territory of Brcko..we informed them there would be no peace, nor Dayton."

- Bosnians opting for voluntary return to their country by end of 1996 will receive 4,800 German marks per adult and 2,400 per child from Swiss government. The Swiss launched the programme in August this year to boost refugee returns to Bosnia.
- "The Croat-Moslem Federation financial system will be completed and its functioning normalised by January 1st," Jadranko Prlic, federation Foreign Minister told reporters.
